# Business README Skill Sync Rule

When changing business API docs in README.md:

- Update .github/skills/business-erd/SKILL.md in the same task.
- Ensure route list in README and skill file match exactly.
- Ensure behavior notes (transaction/default policy/update rules) match service implementation.

Do not finish the task until README and skill file are aligned.
